Seamless loops and tiles via circle/torus mapping of existing noise samplers.

common, grids, simplexcommon, perlins, opensimplexes, values, cellulars, simd/avx2, simd/gridavx2, simd/runtimecheck

Allocates a 2D tiled grid and calls the buffer-taking overload. Source   Edit   
func tileGrid[T: TileNoise2D; S, P: SomeNumber](noise: T; start: (S, S);
    dimens: (int, int); period: (P, P); buffer: var openArray[float32])
Fills a seamless 2D tile by mapping both axes onto a torus in 4D noise. Simplex and Perlin support this mapping. Periods are in world units. Extra buffer elements are untouched. Invalid input raises before writes. Source   Edit

func tileGrid[T: TileNoise; S, P: SomeNumber](noise: T; start: S; width: int;
    period: P; buffer: var openArray[float32])
Fills a seamless 1D loop using a circle through the 2D noise sampler. Period is in world units; samples advance by one and exclude the endpoint. Extra buffer elements are untouched. Invalid input raises before writes. Source   Edit
